verdict.rationale: The product has its own stakeholder-facing view: holders click 'My Equity' to see their grants and exercise options. Stockholders can also be brought into the platform to review and sign consents. But the evidence shows only employee option grants in that view, not investors seeing their preferred or common holdings, and no structured investor-update feature is documented. Missing for 10: an evidenced investor-specific portal showing holdings, a structured investor updates or reporting feature, and independent corroboration.
